h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Darbhanga

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Darbhanga

items.pText: Darbhanga is the cultural centre of Mithila in north Bihar, a region known for Madhubani painting and for the rivers that flood its plains most monsoons. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Darbhanga's schools, colleges, hospitals and residential colonies from our factory in Vasai, about 1,530 km away. We send the equipment by road and install it with our team or a dealer.

Schools in Mithila sometimes ask whether a playground can carry a local look. Our standard pieces come in 15+ roto-moulded colours, and design customisation is available on request. A school can choose a palette inspired by the bold reds, yellows and greens of local art, or ask us about custom panels. Share what you have in mind with your enquiry, and we will tell you what is possible for your order.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Much of the land around Darbhanga sits low and stays waterlogged after heavy rain. Before installation, raise the play area with compacted fill above the usual water level, and slope it to a drain.

Grout the posts into concrete footings, which hold steady when the soil softens. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic come through floodwater without rusting, but clear silt from the equipment and flooring once the water drops. Install in the dry months, after the rains. A

items.q: Can playground colours reflect local art?
items.a: We have 15+ roto-moulded colours, so a school can choose a palette inspired by local art. Design customisation is available on request, and we will confirm what is possible for your order.

items.q: What happens to playground equipment after a flood?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic do not rust in floodwater. Once the water drops, wash off silt, check fixings and clear the drains around the play area.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Darbhanga?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai and send the equipment to Darbhanga by road. Our team or a Bihar dealer installs it.
